title: Flow Field
summary: 2,600 particles riding a seeded noise field. Pointer bends the current, click reseeds.
prompt: Canvas flow-field particle system: seeded value noise, additive trails, pointer disturbance, reseed on click, density and speed sliders.
notes: Particles are pooled; density slider adds/removes entries instead of reallocating. Trails come from a low-alpha fill, not per-particle history.
